Title: Login button does nothing on the sign-in screen
Description:
Module: Sign in
Platform: Web

Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the sign-in page.
2. Enter a valid email and password.
3. Click Login.

Actual Result:
Nothing happens.

Expected Result:
The user is signed in and sent to the dashboard.
